faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before creating and downloading your resume.
faq.q1: How much does it cost to create and download my resume?
faq.a1: We offer 4 clear plans: Flash Pass for $1.99 (single download + ATS check), Pro Pass for $3.99 (7-day unlimited + AI ATS Check), Monthly Pass at $7.99/month, and Annual Pass at $39.99/year (Save 50%). You can build and preview your resume for free before any payment.
faq.q2: How does the AI improve my experience without fabricating details?
faq.a2: Our AI acts like a certified recruitment coach: it analyzes your real daily tasks and rewrites them using powerful action verbs and industry-tailored terminology. It is strictly programmed to NEVER invent companies, dates, or degrees.
faq.q3: Is my resume compatible with ATS screening software?
faq.a3: Yes, absolutely. All 10 professional templates follow strict Applicant Tracking System (ATS) parsing guidelines: clean structural hierarchy, standard fonts, and optimized layout.
faq.q4: Can I edit my resume after downloading it?
faq.a4: Yes, your resume stays saved in your private dashboard. You can return anytime to edit info, adjust content, or change templates at no additional cost.
faq.q5: Is the cover letter generator included?
faq.a5: Yes! Our platform includes AI cover letter generation tailored to your resume background and the specific company you are targeting.
